acceptance.assertion: A heartbeat is recordable, renewal advances the projected expires_at, and a worker renewing on schedule is never reported in expired_leases across a simulated long-running unit; recovery counts are not inflated by live workers. Reproduced by the coordinator: HEARTBEAT is absent from EVENT_KINDS.
acceptance.falsified_if: a renewing worker is still reported expired, or renewal is not durably recorded

hypothesis: Lease renewal cannot be recorded at all, because HEARTBEAT is not an admissible event kind and project_units has no case for it, so a healthy renewing worker is reported as an expired lease and can be evicted while alive.

source_hashes.note: Pinned by commit rather than by working-tree hash, per the a12-u02 remediation and the source-capsule drift finding.
